description: One page of the For you home feed, decoded into posts and a continuation cursor. The HTTP method, query id and features are observed from x.com and refreshed when rejected.
observation_recipe: open https://x.com/home and record the HomeTimeline request
open https://x.com/home again in a fresh run and record the request
scroll to record a continuation with a cursor from the first response
re-observe after a rejected query id
verification_cases: identity: tweet ids match the browser response
attribution: author id and handle come from core.user_results
continuation: page two uses the Bottom cursor from page one
auth failure: 401 or 403 stops the run
rate limit: 429 is retried with backoff
unknown shape: post-bearing modules fail the page
